common.tagline: Personal health research for your body, not women in general
common.disclaimer: Wellness & Decision Support: This app does not provide medical diagnosis or prescriptions. Always consult a qualified doctor.
common.emergencyWarning: Emergency Notice: If you experience severe pain, heavy bleeding, chest pain, fainting, or acute symptoms, call 112 or visit an emergency room immediately.

settings.title: Account & Privacy Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your consent preferences, export your medical data, or delete your account.

settings.deleteDesc: Permanently erase your account, health profile, check-ins, and all associated medical data.
